entities.name: Eglė Šulčiūtė
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eglė Šulčiūtė is a Lithuanian professional basketball player. She plays for USO Mondeville (France) and Lithuania women's national basketball team. She has represented national team in several EuroBasket Women competitions. In 2005, she won in LMKL with Vilniaus Lietuvos telekomas.
